visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in an orange t-shirt and a woman with red hair in a bun pose for a mirror selfie in a brightly lit indoor space with retail branding visible behind them. They look intimately at the phone camera as the man pouts. (2) A sharp cut to another young man with messy dark hair, wearing a black face mask and a white t-shirt with a gold chain, looking directly into the camera lens with a neutral expression. (3) The original couple is seated on an open-top sightseeing bus at night, wearing transparent raincoats. The background shows blurred city lights and street traffic; they look at the camera smiling while the girl makes a peace sign. (4) Inside a metro station entrance near yellow and white directional signboards, the couple leans in for a kiss, appearing focused on each other. Suddenly, Steve, the man with the black mask, pops his head into the left side of the frame. (5) In front of a large stone historical archway (Ruins of St. Paul's), the couple poses with peace signs while Steve stands next to them, also holding a gimbal, creating a group shot in the bright daylight. (6) At an outdoor park with a landmark tower behind them, the man tries to pucker his lips towards the woman, who is distracted drinking from a plastic water bottle, wearing a blue knitted top. (7) In a dimly lit hotel room with unmade beds, the man, now shirtless, and woman sit closely on a green armchair. Steve's face is seen in the extreme foreground left, watching them intently. (8) A final selfie shot shows Steve and the man from the couple posing together; Steve makes a peace sign while the other man gives a thumbs up.
